content.value: Consider the following course dependency graph. An edge from course x to course y (14) [CO3] indicates that course x must be completed before course y can be taken. Design an algorithm to find a sequential order of courses that a student can undertake. Also find a sequence for the given graph applying your proposed algorithm.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 2nd Year 1st Term Regular Examination, 2023
